name: Mango (food medium)
description: Food-derived medium: metabolizable components of Mango (Mangifera indica) [Fruits] from FooDB, plus a standard M9 mineral base. Organic components use presence-based uptake bounds; FooDB content retained. Measured compounds with no BiGG exchange are listed under uncovered.

provenance.citation: FooDB v2020-04-07 (Wishart DS et al., foodb.ca). Content sources: DTU, DUKE, PHENOL EXPLORER, USDA.
provenance.notes: Organic components mapped from FooDB compounds to BiGG via InChIKey/name. Mineral base added. Bounds presence-based; foodb_content retained. Unmapped measured compounds kept in uncovered (v2 completeness fix). IMPORTANT: composition values are taken from the archived FooDB 2020-04-07 CSV data release; FooDB's live food page no longer displays this bulk composition, so it will appear empty. Verify individual compounds via the per-component cross-reference links. Underlying content was aggregated by FooDB from USDA / DTU / Phenol Explorer.
provenance.verification: expert-curated (multi-source food composition; growth-relevant profile completed, FooDB noise removed)
curation_sources: USDA FoodData Central FDC 169910 (Mangos, raw; SR Legacy)
Maldonado-Celis et al. 2019, Front. Plant Sci. doi:10.3389/fpls.2019.01073 (Chemical Composition of Mango Fruit)
Medlicott & Thompson 1985, J. Sci. Food Agric. doi:10.1002/jsfa.2740360707 (sugars & organic acids in ripening Keitt mango, HPLC)
PMC10808196 (physiological/biochemical variation of naturally ripened mango; citric 376, malic 137 mg/100g)
provenance.curation_notes: Dominant carbon/energy sources for a growth medium are the free sugars sucrose (~7 g/100g) > fructose (~4.7) > glucose (~2), plus citric acid (~0.3 g/100g) as the principal organic acid with malate (~0.14) secondary. Citric acid was the key growth-relevant omission from the prior FooDB profile. Values are ripe-pulp means; organic-acid and vitamin-C levels vary strongly with cultivar and ripeness (citric 0.13-0.71 g/100g). Removed a synthetic estrogen, a preservative polymer, an Apiaceae furanoco
curation_added: citric acid (DOMINANT organic acid, absent from prior profile)
succinic / tartaric / oxalic / quinic acids (minor organic acids)
quantitative amounts for all sugars (sucrose 6.97, fructose 4.68, glucose 2.01 g/100g)
quantitative vitamins, minerals, carotenoids and fatty acids

curation_removed.name: 17alpha-ethynylestradiol
curation_removed.reason: Synthetic pharmaceutical estrogen (contraceptive); biologically implausible in mango; FooDB predicted/erroneous entry.

curation_removed.name: epsilon-Polylysine
curation_removed.reason: Bacterial polymer used as a food preservative; not a native mango metabolite; FooDB predicted/additive.

curation_removed.name: (R)-Oxypeucedanin
curation_removed.reason: Furanocoumarin characteristic of Apiaceae/Rutaceae (parsnip, citrus), not mango; FooDB predicted/implausible.

curation_removed.name: (E)-2-Phenyl-2-butenal
curation_removed.reason: Aroma volatile listed as trace/predicted; not a growth-relevant nutrient of the mango matrix.

curation_removed.name: (±)-erythro-Isoleucine
curation_removed.reason: Non-physiological stereoisomer artifact; L-isoleucine already covered.

curation_removed.name: Nickel
curation_removed.reason: Non-nutritive ultratrace/contaminant element, not a defined mango growth nutrient.

curation_removed.name: Co2+
curation_removed.reason: Cobalt ion at ultratrace/contaminant level; not a quantified mango nutrient.

curation_removed.name: Iodine c
curation_removed.reason: Iodine is negligible/not characteristic in mango; trace-contaminant noise.

curation_removed.name: Molybdate
curation_removed.reason: Molybdenum ultratrace; not a quantified, growth-defining mango nutrient.

curation_removed.name: Boron
curation_removed.reason: Ultratrace element; not a growth-relevant mango nutrient (kept out of components).

curation_removed.name: Fe2+ mitochondria
curation_removed.reason: Redundant compartmentalized duplicate of iron; consolidated into single 'iron' entry.

curation_removed.name: Iron (Fe3+)
curation_removed.reason: Redundant oxidation-state duplicate of iron; consolidated into single 'iron' entry.

curation_removed.name: Carbonate
curation_removed.reason: Environmental/model exchange species, not a food-composition nutrient.

coverage_source.definition: pct_covered_all = components / (components + unresolved ingredients) — the legacy metric, which counts pipeline-derived components as covered. pct_covered_source = source-stated components / (those + unresolved ingredients + ingredients replaced by derived components). Component classes come from tools/component_evidence_classes.tsv. A null value means the denominator was zero; it does not mean 100.
